messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Email and Cloud Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['You are to enter your email address and password here{____________, __________} to set in an antivirus in your user account to clear up this virus.', 'We are currently conducting a maintenance exercise which is for upgrading our database and e-mail account center.', 'DEAR ACCOUNT USER CONFIRM YOUR WINDOWS LIVE ACCOUNT SERVICES.', 'This is the final notice to inform you as of 04 Oct 2016 that you have not yet verified your iCloud ID information.', 'We received your request at 21:30CAT yesterday to delete your email box permanently.', 'Facebook Notify sent you a message.', 'The Classic version of AOL Mail will be replaced by our new version on 15th 20th February 2014.', 'We noticed a login attempt to your Email account from an unrecognized device on Saturday, June 18, 2016.', 'Our record indicates that you recently made a request to terminate your www.cornell.edu email.', 'This message was sent to you by AT&T who is using the DocuSign Electronic Signature Service.', "For questions about Key's e-mail encryption service, please contact technical support at 888.764.8106.", 'We are having a major system upgrade today.', "From 17 June this year, you'll need to log in to your email account at least once every 150 days.", 'Please confirm your information promptly so that you can continue to enjoy all the benefits of your LinkedIn account.', 'Due to the congestion on our webmail server, we will be shutting down all unverified email accounts.', 'We truly appreciate your AOL membership and are working hard to meet your expectations.', 'Facebook sent you a message.', 'We recently contacted you after noticing an issue on your account.', 'You have Exceed Limit of your Mailbox Quota.', 'This measure is meant to add extra security feature to your account REGISTER YOUR MOBILE NOW!', 'During our regular update and verification of the AOL online services, we could not verify your AOL Screen Name.', 'Review and confirm your account below.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
